theorem bbolt.Bucket.pageNode_w.wp_proof [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt
    Fs.fsExt] (hpage : bbolt.Tx.page.spec) (hRP : bbolt.internal.common.InBucket.RootPage.spec) :
    bbolt.Bucket.pageNode_w.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Bucket.pageNode_w.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (K : bbolt.BC) (tx : Loc) (r : bbolt.TxReg) (m : Bool) (X : bbolt.WX) (bl : Loc) (B : bbolt.BRec) (id : w64),
    X.t.bs !! bl = some B →
      bl ∈ X.liveB →
        (B.ib.root' = W64 0 → id = W64 0) →
          (B.bv.nodes' = null → B.nm = ∅) →
            (∀ (c : w64) (l : Loc), B.nm !! c = some l → l ≠ null) →
              (bbolt.resolve B id = none →
                  ∃ pa pg,
                    bbolt.wpageAt X.v B id = some (pa, pg) ∧
                      (B.ib.root' = W64 0 → B.pst = bbolt.PageSt.view ∨ ∃ dq, B.isrc = bbolt.Src.own dq) ∧
                        (B.ib.root' ≠ W64 0 →
                          X.t.pm !! id = none ∧
                            16 ≤ pg.length ∧
                              bbolt.pageId pg = BitVec.toNat id ∧
                                (bbolt.pageFlags pg = bbolt.branchPageFlag ∨ bbolt.pageFlags pg = bbolt.leafPageFlag) ∧
                                  BitVec.toNat id * 4096 < 281474976710655)) →
                ⊢
                  ∀ Φ,
                    bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X -∗
                      (▷
                          ∀ p n,
                            bbolt.wtxW K tx r m X ∗
                                ⌜match bbolt.resolve B id with
                                  | some l => p = null ∧ n = l
                                  | none => n = null ∧ ∃ pg, bbolt.wpageAt X.v B id = some (p, pg)⌝ -∗
                              Φ (intoVal p, intoVal n)) -∗
                        WP
                          ((intoVal
                              (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.Bucket.ty.PointerType
                                go!"pageNode" (intoVal bl)))
                            (intoVal id))
